triggers.name: Urgency
triggers.definition: Encourage immediate action by emphasizing genuine time constraints or deadlines.
positive_examples: Doors close at midnight tonight.
Faites-le maintenant, plus vous attendez...
negative_examples: Spots are limited... (but no real limit exists)

triggers.name: Scarcity
triggers.definition: Create desire by limiting availability of products, services, or opportunities.
positive_examples: Only 5 spots left in this exclusive program.
Plus que 5 places disponibles
negative_examples: Limited time offer (but no real scarcity)

triggers.name: Social Proof
triggers.definition: Influence behavior by showing that others are doing it or have succeeded.
positive_examples: Join 10,000+ satisfied customers.
Cette méthode a déjà transformé la vie de plus de 500 hommes

triggers.name: Authority
triggers.definition: Establish credibility through expertise, credentials, or recognized status.
positive_examples: Dr. Smith, certified nutritionist with 20 years experience.
Expert certifié avec 20 ans d'expérience
negative_examples: Faux diplômes ou affirmations non vérifiées

triggers.name: Reciprocity
triggers.definition: Give something first to create obligation and increase likelihood of compliance.
positive_examples: Free consultation with no obligation.
Consultation gratuite sans engagement

triggers.name: Commitment & Consistency
triggers.definition: Get small commitments that lead to larger ones, leveraging people's need to be consistent.
positive_examples: Commit to your goals and see them through.
Engagez-vous dans vos objectifs
negative_examples: Forcer des engagements sans intérêt réel

triggers.name: Liking
triggers.definition: Increase influence through similarity, compliments, cooperation, and positive associations.
positive_examples: People like you have found success with this method.
Des personnes comme vous ont réussi avec cette méthode

triggers.name: Fear
triggers.definition: Motivate action by highlighting potential losses, missed opportunities, or negative consequences.
positive_examples: Don't let this opportunity pass you by.
Ne laissez pas passer cette opportunité
negative_examples: Créer de fausses peurs ou panique

triggers.name: Greed
triggers.definition: Appeal to desire for more money, success, benefits, or material gains.
positive_examples: Double your income in 90 days.
Doublez vos revenus en 90 jours

triggers.name: Mystery
triggers.definition: Create curiosity and anticipation by not revealing everything at once.
positive_examples: Don't say everything you know.
Ne pas tout dire
negative_examples: Creating false mystery or misleading teasers
Créer de faux mystères ou teasers trompeurs

triggers.name: Curiosity Gap
triggers.definition: Create information gaps that people feel compelled to fill.
positive_examples: Are you curious about what happens next?
Êtes-vous curieux de savoir ce qui se passe ensuite ?
negative_examples: Créer de fausse curiosité ou du clickbait

triggers.name: Exclusivity
triggers.definition: Make people feel special by offering VIP access or membership to elite groups.
positive_examples: Exclusive access for VIP members only.
Accès exclusif pour les membres VIP seulement

triggers.name: Storytelling
triggers.definition: Use narrative structure to engage emotions and make messages memorable.
positive_examples: Let me tell you a story about success.
Laissez-moi vous raconter une histoire de succès

triggers.name: Contrast
triggers.definition: Highlight differences between options to make one choice more appealing.
positive_examples: Before vs After: See the dramatic difference.
Avant vs Après : voyez la différence dramatique

triggers.name: Call to Action
triggers.definition: Direct instructions that tell people exactly what to do next.
positive_examples: Click here to get started now.
Cliquez ici pour commencer maintenant
